function.description: Selects variable functions for fractal types that expose function slots.

showorbit.description: Starts image generation with orbit display enabled.

inside.description: Selects the interior color or interior coloring method for points that do not escape.

maxiter.description: Sets the maximum iteration count before a point is treated as inside the set.

center-mag.description: Sets the image area by center point, magnification, and optional stretch, rotation, and skew.

fn1.description: Selects fn1 in the Mandelfn z(n+1)=c*fn1(z) formula.
